release_read.basis: Q3 revenue $57.9M against a ~$42.2M bar (+37%), non-GAAP EPS $0.50 against Nasdaq's $0.34, and FY26 guide raised from at least $145M to more than $175M with the adjusted EBITDA margin guide raised from 35% to at least 40%; a beat-and-raise well beyond the thesis on a thin-coverage name whose last raise bought +44%, sized a little above the 20.4% implied move.

release.headline: Eton Pharmaceuticals Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

vs_bar.consensus_source: includes $12.9M valuation-allowance tax benefit; not comparable

key_line.detail: Raised to more than $175M from more than $145M (+21%); adj. EBITDA margin guide raised to at least 40% from 35%; Q3 adj. EBITDA $28.5M (49%); $200M annualized run rate passed. The release does not state a time of day; 21:05Z is an assumption, shortly after the close and before the 16:30 ET call.

guidance.detail: FY26 revenue >$175M (was >$145M), adj. EBITDA margin >=40% (was >35%), despite the Libervant licence the thesis flagged as the margin offset.

call.detail: Call held last night; transcript not read in the time available, so nothing from Q&A is reflected.

public_reaction.summary: Analyst actions, press and retail tone were not searched for lack of time; only the release and an aggregator summary of it were read. media_tone reflects the release-led coverage only.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 58.86 = +24.8% vs prev close 47.15, against a frozen release read of +24.0% and an implied move of 20.4%: the pre-market already holds what the release supports. After hours was already +23.0%, so the move was read overnight. But the pre-market is thin and stale: 9 prints, 3 in the last 30 min, last print 08:59, stale_at_open true. Range 56.06-58.96. Position is up about 20.6% from entry 48.79.

thesis_check.note: Thesis was Q3 above $42.2M on the first full Hemangeol quarter plus a third FY raise; both came in far larger than the $43-46M the hunt worked out, and the margin guide rose rather than falling on Libervant.

expected.open_lag_note: amc beat-and-raise with after hours (+23.0%) and pre-market (+24.8%) agreeing, so the open should hold most of the move despite a stale, thin pre-market (raising p_open_lags a little); a +25% gap beyond the implied move on a small-cap tends to give part back in the first half hour.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers en de verhoogde jaarprognose zijn duidelijk beter dan verwacht, maar de voorbeurskoers (+24,8%) houdt al ongeveer precies wat die cijfers rechtvaardigen en ligt boven de verwachte beweging uit de opties. Na een hele nacht is het nieuws verwerkt en grote koerssprongen geven na de opening vaak iets terug, dus verkoop bij de opening, zoals de standaardregel.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurskoers voor 09:30 terugzakt onder ongeveer +15% terwijl er geen negatief nieuws is, dan is de stijging onvolledig en is houden tot het slot beter.
